int meta_dflt (  noir_md *  a,
meta_flags  flags,
meta_type  type,
const char *  k,
const char *  d,
const char *  g,
const char *  v,
noir_provider *  p
) 
 

set a default for a meta-data entry: meta_add() only if value does not already exist.

sometimes, a meta-data entry must be created even if it is not warranted by the file we wish to describe. for instance, if no "genre" information is set on a MP3 song, we will still want to create a "genre"-entry in the meta-data so the info-dialog will create a "genre" edit-field. to do this, the provider's meta_get_for_file() function should first create entries for all meta-data it can get from the file, and then call meta_dflt() for all items that an entry must exist for "no matter what."

Returns:
an error-code
Parameters:
a - the list
flags - the flags for the entry (read-only etc.)
type - the type of the entry (integer, UTF8, ...)
k - the name of the entry
d - the description for the entry, or NULL
g - the group the entry should appear in
v - the value for the entry, or NULL
p - the provider that created the entry
